authentication.rule: Each SPRITEFONT input is byte-identical to the member of the pinned upstream source archive; the clean-tree rule omits the .spritefont suffix, so the fonts are supplied beside the generated assets and are not part of any pinned tree hash.

provenance.derivedBy: scripts/xxmi-derive-build-plan.py from the previous plan as template; verified by an independent scripts/xxmi-rebuild-payload.py run that reproduced every object and all three candidates.

upstream.cleanTreeRule: Every upstream archive file whose lower-case suffix is one of .asm .bat .c .cpp .def .filters .h .hpp .ini .md .ps1 .rc .sh .sln .txt .vcxproj .yml, plus an empty version.generated.h. The same rule reproduces the v1.2.2 pin 77862e4e (631 files).

toolchain.msvc: MSVC 14.44.35207 from the frozen Visual Studio 17.14.0 channel: Tools.HostX64.TargetX64.base 4e934097e6e79104ba8c8c2bf53368a8dd607adaf72735073baaaaf4c9ac4a2c, CRT.Headers.base ebd3da53ce156a1edb9613f518cf58fc8c79cebeb44c4861d49e2ae0ea8b9c84, CRT.x64.Desktop.base 041a81bf7c7ad02deb5a1ab7093d93e770e3a61563f65e524a435bb9dacae8bf
toolchain.note: These restored headers reproduce 25 of the 34 previous v1.2.2 stage-3 first-party objects byte for byte (COFF timestamp cleared); the earlier header set is not available, so this plan pins the restored set.

thirdPartyObjects.origin: Rebuilt from source on 2026-11-04 with the toolchain above (DirectXTK 36, PCRE2 25, NktHookLib 14, x64 MASM helper 1), with the NktHookLib relocatable-code blob corrected to zero .text relocations. The v1.2.2 plan's MSVC-built third-party objects are no longer available; v1.2.3 does not change any third-party source.
thirdPartyObjects.linkAdjustment: clang COFF third-party objects carry only the libcpmt default-library directive, so libcmt.lib, libvcruntime.lib and libucrt.lib are listed explicitly in every stage's link response.
